remarks: MOVE-IN READY! Bright and sun filled tri-level end unit Townhouse with three bedrooms and two updated baths. Spacious Living room with picture window, hardwood floor and recessed lighting. Upgraded kitchen/dining room with granite countertop, stainless steel appliances, tile floor, laundry area and exit to outside deck with steps to huge backyard with garden area. The primary bedroom features two big custom-made closets and hardwood floors. Good size two additional bedrooms with ceiling fans and hardwood floors. The lower level offers recessed lighting, storage room, utility room and even guest sleeping space. Attic with pull down stairs, two reserved parking spots and pet friendly well maintained complex. Located within walking distance of Cummings Park and Chelsea Piers. Minutes to I-95 and downtown Stamford. Don't miss! Please submit all highest and best offers by 5 pm 7/17.
